name: Weft and Warp
text: With graceful poise, you perform a dance of dangerous attacks. Stride up to half your speed toward an enemy; if you end this movement adjacent to them make a melee Strike against that foe. If you hit, you can Reposition the target into your square at the same time that you Step into their square. You then make another Strike against the same target, who is Off-Guard to the attack. Finally, you can Step away from that enemy.
